A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a '''lieutenant''' in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] served aboard the ''[[Black Talon]]'', a transport in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], and was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the ''Black Talon'' was hijacked by Imperials working for [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
